nodes.label: NewCommand (otelcol CLI)
nodes.desc: Builds the cobra root command, wires the --config flag and runs the Collector

nodes.label: Collector (Run / Shutdown)
nodes.desc: Top-level process owner: resolves config, starts the Service, watches for reloads and OS signals

nodes.label: ConfigProvider
nodes.desc: Serves the service configuration via Get/Watch/Shutdown and unmarshals it into Config

nodes.label: confmap Resolver.Resolve
nodes.desc: Merges maps from all configured locations and expands ${env:VAR} references

nodes.label: URI providers (file, env, http, yaml)
nodes.desc: Pluggable Provider interface behind file:, env:, http(s): and yaml: schemes

nodes.label: Service (New / Start)
nodes.desc: Builds internal telemetry, extensions and the component graph; owns start and shutdown order

nodes.label: graph.Host
nodes.desc: component.Host holding builder factories, the flow graph, extensions and status reporting

nodes.label: graph.Build (DAG)
nodes.desc: Turns the service config into a directed acyclic graph of component instances

nodes.label: receiverNode
nodes.desc: One node per receiver instance; wraps next consumers in a fan-out and obsconsumer

nodes.label: processorNode
nodes.desc: One node per processor instance; unique per signal flow, chained in config order

nodes.label: exporterNode
nodes.desc: One node per exporter instance; wrapped in obsconsumer and refconsumer

nodes.label: pdata: Traces / Metrics / Logs
nodes.desc: OTLP-native in-memory representation all components exchange (ptrace, pmetric, plog)
